instructions.name: attest_completion
docs: Called by the off-chain attestor after it verified a workout session.
`reps` is reps for push-ups/squats and seconds for plank; it must meet the committed goal.

accounts.name: attestor
docs: Must be the attestor snapshotted into this day's DayState (not the current pool.attestor),
so rotating the pool attestor never changes who can attest a live day.

instructions.name: claim
docs: User only signer. Completed on a finalized day: principal + bonus. Revoked on a finalized
day: principal. Any status on a voided day: principal. Closes the Commitment (rent to user)
so it can never pay twice.

accounts.name: user_token
docs: Any token account of the stake mint (payout destination), except the vault itself.

instructions.name: close_missed
docs: Permissionless (the user may crank it themselves): close a missed commitment after
finalize. The stake was already counted as forfeited at finalize; this refunds rent only.

instructions.name: commit
docs: Stake `amount` base units on doing `goal_target` reps (seconds for plank / wall sit) of `exercise`
during pool day `day_index` (today or tomorrow). User is the only signer and pays rent.

accounts.name: sgt_token
docs: Required iff pool.require_sgt. Validated in handler against `device`.

accounts.name: device
docs: Required iff pool.require_sgt. PDA ["device", pool, sgt_mint] created by register_device.
Owner + discriminator are checked by Account<>; DeviceLock accounts can only be created by
register_device at that PDA after assert_is_sgt, so the handler's `device.pool == pool` and
`sgt_token.mint == device.sgt_mint` checks bind it without re-deriving the address.

instructions.name: finalize_day
docs: Permissionless crank once the day's review window is over: now > attest deadline (extended
by any pause) + finalize_delay_secs. Blocked while the pool is paused, so an incident pause
can never forfeit users whose attestation was pending; the authority voids or unpauses.
Fixes the day's bonus pool.

instructions.name: fund_reserve
docs: Anyone (sponsor) can top up the reserve. Only drawn via each day's sponsor_cap snapshot of
daily_sponsor_amount (0 by default, never above max_stake).

instructions.name: initialize_pool
docs: Upgrade-authority only. Creates the pool for `mint` and its vault token account.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Becomes pool.authority and pays rent. Must be the program's upgrade authority.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's ProgramData account. Only the program's upgrade authority may create
a pool, so nobody can front-run the canonical ["pool", SKR] PDA after deploy.
(Anchor runs `init` before other constraints; a failed check reverts the whole tx.)

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Two-step authority transfer. Pass Pubkey::default() to cancel.

instructions.name: register_device
docs: One DeviceLock per Seeker Genesis Token mint (== per physical device). User signs and pays.

accounts.name: sgt_mint
docs: Must be a Token-2022 mint; SGT extension checks run in the handler.

instructions.name: revoke_completion
docs: Escape hatch for a bad attestation: the authority or the day's attestor can undo it while
the (pause-extended) attestation window is open. A revoked commitment is NEVER forfeited:
it becomes Revoked and its owner can only claim the principal back, without a bonus. So a
revocation can never turn anyone's stake into someone else's payout (audit SM-1 / AUD-AT-1).
The attestor cannot revoke while the pool is paused; the authority can.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The pool authority or the day's snapshotted attestor.

instructions.name: sweep_day
docs: Permissionless: once the day is over and every commitment is resolved, move rounding
dust to the reserve and close DayState (rent back to whoever created it).

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Authority only. Applies the given fields, then re-validates the whole config.
Days that already exist are unaffected: their fee, streak rules, attest deadline, attestor,
sponsor cap and finalize delay are snapshotted in DayState. Pausing extends the attest
window of existing days by the time spent paused and blocks finalize while paused.

instructions.name: void_day
docs: Safety valve (attestor outage / compromise / incident pause): every committer gets principal
back, no slashing. Allowed until the day is finalized, i.e. through the whole review window.

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Authority can only ever withdraw accrued fees - never principal or the reserve directly.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Pubkey::default() = proposal cancelled.

types.name: Commitment
docs: One stake for one day. PDA: ["commitment", pool, user, day_index_le].
Byte layout (incl. the 8-byte discriminator) is FROZEN for getProgramAccounts memcmp:
0 discriminator | 8 bump | 9 status | 10 pool | 42 user | 74 day_index (u32 LE)
| 78 version | 79 exercise | 80 goal_target | 84 amount | ... (see SPEC.md §2.4)

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version (placed after day_index so pool/user/day_index keep their offsets).

fields.name: goal_target
docs: User-picked goal, locked at commit: reps, or seconds for timed holds (plank, wall sit).

fields.name: amount
docs: Stake in base units, chosen by the user within [pool.min_stake, pool.max_stake].

fields.name: weight
docs: Bonus weight (amount * streak multiplier); set at attestation, 0 otherwise.

fields.name: reps
docs: Attested result: reps, or SECONDS held for timed holds (plank, wall sit). >= goal_target.

fields.name: session_hash
docs: sha256 of the canonical session summary the attestor verified.

fields.name: device
docs: SGT mint used for this commit, or Pubkey::default() when SGT not required.

fields.name: goal_target
docs: Reps (push-ups/squats) or seconds (plank).

fields.name: reps
docs: Reps (push-ups/squats) or seconds (plank); always >= goal_target.

types.name: ConfigUpdated
docs: Emitted with the full post-update configuration.

fields.name: revoked_stake
docs: Stake of revoked commitments: refunded, never forfeited.

types.name: DayState
docs: Per-day aggregate. PDA: ["day", pool, day_index_le]. Created by the day's first commit
(which pays its rent and gets it back at sweep_day).

fields.name: attest_deadline
docs: day_end(d) + attest_grace_secs at creation (the NOMINAL deadline). Attest/revoke while
now <= effective_attest_deadline (this + time the pool spent paused since the day was
created); finalize once now > that + finalize_delay_secs and the pool is not paused.

fields.name: resolved_count
docs: Commitments closed via claim or close_missed.

fields.name: distributable
docs: Bonus pool for completers: forfeited - fee + sponsor.

fields.name: attestor
docs: Pool attestor when the day was created: the only key that may attest (or, besides the
authority, revoke) on this day.

fields.name: sponsor_cap
docs: pool.daily_sponsor_amount at creation: the most finalize may draw from the reserve.

fields.name: finalize_delay_secs
docs: Pool finalize_delay_secs at creation.

fields.name: paused_secs_base
docs: Pool total paused seconds at creation; pauses after this extend the attest window.

fields.name: revoked_count
docs: Revoked commitments: never forfeited, claim refunds principal only.

types.name: DeviceLock
docs: One per Seeker device (SGT mint). PDA: ["device", pool, sgt_mint]

fields.name: commit_count
docs: Number of commitments made with this device.

fields.name: recent_days
docs: The two highest day indices committed with this device, recent_days[0] >= recent_days[1].
Only the first min(commit_count, 2) entries are meaningful.

types.name: Exercise
docs: Exercise a commitment is for. Borsh-encoded as one byte (the variant index).
The order is FROZEN: codes are stored on-chain in Commitment.exercise and index
Pool.goal_limits. New exercises are only ever appended.

types.name: GoalLimits
docs: Inclusive goal bounds for one exercise (reps, or seconds for plank / wall sit).

fields.name: min_stake
docs: Inclusive per-commitment stake bounds in base units (0 < min <= max <= ceiling).

fields.name: day_length_secs
docs: 300..=86_400. IMMUTABLE after init (86_400 on mainnet).

fields.name: day_offset_secs
docs: 0 <= offset < day_length_secs. IMMUTABLE after init.

fields.name: goal_limits
docs: Goal bounds indexed by Exercise code (0..EXERCISE_COUNT, enum order).

fields.name: daily_sponsor_amount
docs: <= max_stake.

fields.name: finalize_delay_secs
docs: Review window between a day's attest deadline and finalize: 0..=min(12 h, day length).

types.name: Pool
docs: Global config + accounting. PDA: ["pool", mint]. One pool per stake mint.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version (ACCOUNT_VERSION).

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks commit, attest_completion, finalize_day and attestor-signed revoke_completion.
Never blocks claim / close_missed / sweep. Time spent paused extends the attest window of
every day that existed during the pause (see `paused_secs_total`).

fields.name: require_sgt
docs: Require a Seeker Genesis Token (one commitment per device per day). true on mainnet.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Pubkey::default() when no transfer is pending.

fields.name: attestor
docs: Off-chain verifier key, snapshotted into each DayState when the day is created. Only the
day's snapshot may attest/revoke for that day, so rotating it never affects live days.
Never equal to `authority`.

fields.name: vault
docs: Token account PDA ["vault", pool], authority = pool.

fields.name: day_length_secs
docs: Length of one pool day in seconds (300..=86_400). IMMUTABLE after init.

fields.name: day_offset_secs
docs: Day d starts at d * day_length_secs + day_offset_secs (0 <= offset < length). IMMUTABLE.

fields.name: commit_cutoff_secs
docs: Commits for day d accepted while now < day_start(d) + commit_cutoff_secs.

fields.name: attest_grace_secs
docs: Attestations for day d accepted while now <= day_end(d) + attest_grace_secs
(snapshotted into DayState.attest_deadline when the day is created).

fields.name: min_stake
docs: Inclusive per-commitment stake bounds, base units. 0 < min <= max <= ceiling.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol cut of forfeited stake, bps (snapshotted per day).

fields.name: streak_bonus_bps
docs: Extra bonus weight per consecutive completed day, bps (snapshotted per day).

fields.name: max_streak_bonus_bps
docs: Cap on the streak weight boost, bps (snapshotted per day).

fields.name: goal_limits
docs: Goal bounds indexed by `Exercise as u8` (all EXERCISE_COUNT variants, in enum order).

fields.name: daily_sponsor_amount
docs: Max amount drawn from `reserve` into each finalized day that has completers (snapshotted per
day as DayState.sponsor_cap). 0 by default; never above `max_stake`.

fields.name: reserve
docs: Sponsor deposits + net forfeits of zero-completer days + rounding dust.

fields.name: treasury_accrued
docs: Protocol fees; the ONLY balance the authority can withdraw.

fields.name: outstanding
docs: Sum over live days of what is still owed to committers of that day.

fields.name: finalize_delay_secs
docs: Review window after a day's (pause-extended) attest deadline before finalize_day is allowed
(snapshotted per day). 0..=min(MAX_FINALIZE_DELAY_SECS, day_length_secs).

fields.name: paused_since
docs: Unix time the current pause started; 0 while not paused.

fields.name: total_paused_secs
docs: Total seconds of all completed pauses since the pool was created.

types.name: UpdateConfigParams
docs: Every field optional; day_length_secs and day_offset_secs are deliberately absent (immutable).
All bounds are re-validated on the resulting config.

types.name: UserProfile
docs: Per-user stats. PDA: ["profile", pool, user]

fields.name: completed_days_mask
docs: Bit i set <=> day (last_completed_day - i) is completed (attested, not revoked).
Makes the streak independent of the order in which the attestor submits days.

fields.name: streak_carry
docs: Exact streak ending at day (last_completed_day - 64), i.e. just below the mask window.

fields.name: last_completed_amount
docs: Stake of the commitment completed on last_completed_day: the most of today's stake the
streak boost applies to (the boost only covers stake that was also at risk the day before).
